The Hook: "The Ecosystem of War"
The 3-Step Tactical Loop
1. Infuse (Terraform) ➔ 2. Attune (Adapt) ➔ 3. Consume (Unleash)

🔥 1. Infuse (Terraform)

Spells physically change the ground in real-time. Fireballs burn lush grass into molten lava; water blasts douse flames and create concealing steam clouds.

🌊 2. Attune (Adapt)

Units gain dynamic passive buffs matching the ground beneath them. Standing on lava grants fire units +2 ATK and complete burn immunity.

⚡ 3. Consume (Unleash)

Titans siphon active lava or lakes, turning the land into Barren Earth to gain Elemental Cores that fuel room-clearing ultimate Cataclysms.

Natural Synergy: Every action feeds into the next. Setting tiles ablaze creates hazards to push enemies into, buffs your allied monsters, and generates fuel to cast match-winning Titan finishers.
Speaker Note: "Our core hook creates a natural tactical rhythm: you light the ground on fire, knock an enemy into it, stand in the fire to buff your dragon, drain the land for energy, and wipe out the enemy squad with a volcanic cataclysm."
Core Gameplay: Three Pillars of Combat
Tactical Design Pillars

⛰️ 1. Offensive Terraforming

Don't just cast spells at enemy health bars. Target the ground itself to reshape the battlefield, cut off escape routes, and carve lethal lava moats.

🐉 2. Titan Ecosystems

Colossal allied monsters that feed directly on the environment. The more elemental chaos on the board, the more energy your Titan absorbs for ultimate abilities.

💥 3. Kinetic Shoves & Physics

Directional displacement is lethal. Shoving enemies into rock cliffs deals heavy collision impact damage; knocking them into lava deals continuous burns.

Fast Action Economy: Every unit gets a clean 1 Move + 1 Combat Action per turn. No menu paralysis, no 45-minute slogs—just tight 10-minute spatial puzzles.
Speaker Note: "We focus on three gameplay pillars: offensive terraforming with elemental magic, Titans that feed on the battlefield, and kinetic displacement that makes positioning lethal."

Game Design Solutions: Player-First Combat
Solving Tactical Frustrations

🧠 1. Solving "Cognitive Overload"

The Problem in Classic SRPGs: Classic elemental tactics games overwhelm players with dozens of confusing status effect icons and hidden percentage tables.

Our Solution: Ghost UI (Predictive Preview)
Hovering any spell or push action over a tile immediately previews the exact physical terrain reaction and knockback path before the player commits.

⏳ 2. Solving "Setup Tax"

The Problem in Classic SRPGs: Players hate wasting turns just preparing terrain or placing elemental tiles without dealing actual damage to enemies.

Our Solution: Hybrid Attack-Spells
Every spell acts simultaneously! Fireball deals direct damage to the target AND mutates the ground into lava in 1 action. Kinetic Push deals damage AND displaces.
Speaker Note: "We solved two major tactical RPG frustrations: Ghost UI eliminates cognitive overload by previewing reactions before casting, and hybrid attack-spells remove setup tax so every single turn feels impactful."
Unit Asymmetry: Shapers vs. Titans
Squad Roles & Archetypes

🧙 Human Commanders (The Shapers)

ROLE: Map Manipulator (Low HP, High Mobility, Spatial Control)
Squishy but agile. Casts ranged Fireballs, Water Surges, and Kinetic Pushes to manipulate enemy positioning and shape the terrain from afar.

🐉 Allied Titans (Colossal Anchors)

ROLE: Frontline Finisher (Colossal 14 HP, Hazard-Immune)
Massive frontline anchor. Naturally immune to molten lava, holds down the board with heavy melee strikes, and harvests land to trigger room-clearing Magma Cataclysms.

🔥 Dracomancers (Enemy Bosses)

Role: Tactical Rival Pyromancer
Commands enemy squads, casts long-range fire spells, and uses kinetic knockbacks to shove player units off high ground into hazards.

👿 Demon Slimes (Aggressive Swarmers)

Role: Fast Flanking Minions
Aggressive swarmers that navigate around hazards to flank your Commander and attempt to knock him off elevated plateaus.

Speaker Note: "Every squad features asymmetric roles: your fragile Commander shapes the terrain and controls space, while your Titan holds the frontline, absorbs environmental energy, and delivers the finishing blows."
Campaign Structure: Expeditions & Progression
Meta Progression & Replayability

🗺️ Node-Based Map

Branching expedition map inspired by Slay the Spire and Into the Breach. Choose your path through skirmishes, elemental shrines, mystery encounters, and rest camps.

🔮 Spellbooks & Titans

Unlock new elemental disciplines for your Commander (Ice, Lightning, Earth) and hatch/attune new Titan monsters with unique passive immunities and Cataclysm ultimates.

⏱️ Zero-Grind Pacing

No 20-hour XP grinding. Every skirmish is a tight 10–15 minute spatial challenge where success is driven by player skill, positioning, and creative terrain combos.

Replayability: Procedural encounter routes, emergent environmental chemistry, and diverse squad compositions ensure no two runs feel identical.
Speaker Note: "Beyond individual battles, the campaign features a node-based expedition map with spellbook upgrades, elemental titan customization, and zero level grinding."

Visual Target: HD-2D Diorama & Production Model
Art Direction & Sprite Pipeline

🎨 Visual Target: HD-2D Aesthetic

• Lighting & Atmosphere: Triangle Strategy tilt-shift depth-of-field, dynamic real-time shadows, and glowing emissive lava veins in Unity 6.
• Silhouettes: Final Fantasy Tactics & Tactics Ogre standees.
• Palette: Vanaris Tactics rich fantasy environmental tones.

💥 Tactile Combat Juice

Trauma-based screen shake on wall slams, particle sparks on terrain ignition, and floating telemetry make every impact feel punchy and rewarding.

🖌️ Sprite Pipeline (Lean & Mathematically Viable)

• Format: 2-Directional Isometric Standees (Front & Back-Quarter, like Disgaea & Ragnarok Online).
• Snappy Retro Loops: 3-frame combat loops (Idle, Hop, Attack, Hurt).
• Viability: 6 classes x 2 dirs x 10 keyframes = ~120 frames total. Highly realistic and attractive for freelance pixel artists ($200/class).

🎵 Audio Production: Freelance OST

Procedural sound engine active in Unity. Grant funds commission an indie composer for 2 original orchestral tactical battle themes and custom elemental SFX.

Speaker Note: "For visual and audio production, I'm taking a lean indie approach: I handle 100% of game design and programming, while using the grant to commission specialist freelance pixel artists and an indie composer."
Production Roadmap: 6 Months to Steam Demo
Milestone Schedule

Month 1–2: Art Commissions & Sprites

Commission freelance pixel artist for 2-directional animated sprite sheets (6 classes) and high-res character portrait illustrations.

Month 3: New Biomes & Mechanics

Implement Glacial Peak (ice slide shove physics) and Conductive Marsh (water + lightning chain electrocution).

Month 4: Campaign Map & Smart AI

Build node-based world map progression and enhance enemy AI (flanking, hazard evasion, and tactical retreating).

Month 5–6: Steam Demo & Next Fest

Commission OST battle themes, polish UI/audio, and release a public 30-minute playable demo for Steam Next Fest.

🛡️ Execution Risk = Near Zero: Core combat engine, hex grid math, kinetic displacement, and land-siphoning loops are ALREADY complete and verified in Unity 6 (Month 0). Months 1–6 are strictly for asset commissioning, content expansion, and AI tuning.
Speaker Note: "With the core game mechanics and physics already proven in Unity, the next 6 months are focused purely on production: commissioning custom sprite animations, adding 2 more biomes, and shipping a public Steam demo."
